title: The Blue Notebook Review - Nov. 30 - Dec 6, 2025
description:
Ho Ho Ho! 🎄 The Blue Notebook Review is officially in the holiday spirit.

Sgt. Rick is back with a festive edition of the Blue Notebook Review, complete with seasonal décor brought to life with help from Cadet Alexis (minus the Charlie Brown tree — that one’s on Sgt. Rick).

Whether you celebrate Christmas, Hanukkah, Kwanzaa, Las Posadas, Winter Solstice, or simply the season itself, this episode reflects what this time of year is all about: community, service, and accountability.

This week’s highlights:

• 2,608 calls for service (115,880 YTD)
• 58 arrests | 18 encampments cleaned | 11 5150 holds
• Calls down 4.3%, arrests up 20.7% year-over-year
• Downtown livability operation and notable arrests
• Drone response safely resolves a “man with a gun” call
• 307 traffic stops focused on holiday safety

🎖️ Plus, a historic moment for SMPD — Chief Darrick Jacob is officially appointed, marking the first internal Chief promotion since 1979.

🐾 Holiday joy at the Animal Shelter, thanks to Warner Bros. Animation & DC Studios — and six pets adopted, with donations continuing next week.

It’s a busy season — and our favorite kind of busy.

This is your Blue Notebook Review.
